stations.title: 1st job — GogoshopBD
stations.subtitle: Full Stack Developer (MERN) · Jun 2023 – Feb 2024
stations.text: My first job. Shipped features across the frontend and backend of a live e-commerce platform, optimized database queries and learned what production really means.

stations.text: Completed my B.Sc. in CSE at RP Shaha University with a CGPA of 3.66 — algorithms, systems and a capstone multi-vendor restaurant platform.

stations.title: 2nd job — TS4U IT

stations.text: My second job. Led backend development for Orbit Task through its beta launch and owned the Vocalize Pro backend, integrating OpenAI and social media APIs.

stations.title: ScaleUp Ads Agency
stations.subtitle: Backend Developer · May 2025 – Apr 2026
stations.text: Built production APIs for marketplaces, job platforms, education and logistics apps — authentication, Stripe & RevenueCat payments, real-time Socket.io alerts and secure media.

stations.title: Promoted to Team Leader

stations.text: Now leading the mobile app team at ScaleUp — sprint planning, code review, mentoring and owning client communication, while staying hands-on with the code.

stations.title: The next chapter
stations.subtitle: DevOps & Security
stations.text: Learning Docker, CI/CD, cloud and security — and looking for the next product to build. Maybe it's yours?

intro.title: Follow a request through my backend
intro.text: Scroll to watch one request travel from the app to the database and back — and how I keep every step secure.

stations.title: The request
stations.subtitle: Web & mobile clients
stations.text: A user taps a button in a Flutter app or a Next.js dashboard. The client sends an HTTPS request with a short-lived JWT access token in the Authorization header.

stations.title: The gateway
stations.subtitle: Routing, limits & validation
stations.text: Express routes the request. Before anything else runs, it passes rate limiting, CORS rules and schema validation — bad input never reaches the business logic.

stations.title: Authentication
stations.subtitle: Who are you, and what can you do?
stations.text: One middleware verifies the token, loads the user and checks their role. Google & Apple sign-in map to the same account, and refresh tokens can be revoked instantly.

stations.title: Business logic
stations.subtitle: Services that do the work
stations.text: Typed service layers handle the real rules — orders, subscriptions, payouts. Payments go through Stripe and RevenueCat, and every webhook is verified and idempotent.

stations.title: Data layer
stations.subtitle: Fast, indexed, consistent
stations.text: MongoDB with compound indexes designed from real query patterns, cursor pagination and lean reads. Media lives in Cloudflare R2 and Cloudinary behind signed URLs.

stations.title: Response & real-time
stations.subtitle: Back to the user — instantly
stations.text: A clean JSON response goes back to the app. Events that others need to see — SOS alerts, admin updates — are pushed over Socket.io rooms, with email via Resend as a backup.

stations.title: Learning cyber security
stations.subtitle: What I'm studying now
stations.text: Security is where I'm going deeper: the OWASP Top 10, secure API design, secrets management and pen-testing fundamentals — so the systems I lead are safe by default.
